name: Resonus
subtitle: Official iOS source for Resonus
description: Welcome, here you can find all Resonus iOS versions

apps.name: Resonus
apps.subtitle: A clean Android and iOS music player for your self-hosted server, and your local files.
apps.localizedDescription:
Features
Navidrome / OpenSubsonic / Jellyfin / Ampache: multi-profile login, multi-library support, plus several server addresses with automatic switching
Local mode: play music straight from your device or a folder, no server needed
Offline mode: your favorites, playlists and albums stay browsable with no connection; downloaded songs play, the rest show grayed out, and it switches automatically when the server is unreachable
Downloads: albums, playlists, an artist's whole discography or single songs, in original quality or transcoded
Synced lyrics: karaoke view with tap-to-seek, full-screen mode, optional LRCLIB lookup
Internet radio: browse and manage your stations
Playback: crossfade, ReplayGain normalization, playback speed, sleep timer, queue with undo, shuffle, repeat, background & lock-screen controls
Autoplay & mixes: keep the music going with similar songs, or start a mix from any track
Organize: multi-select (queue, playlist or download in batch), star ratings, pinned items, play history
Themes: dark, light (experimental) or whichever one the phone is on, each with its own accent color
Make it yours: reorder and show/hide Home sections and explore chips, app fonts, configurable swipe and ⋯ menu actions
Landscape and tablet layouts
Queue sync across devices
In 10 languages: English, Spanish, German, Catalan, Russian, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, Polish, Swedish

versions.localizedDescription:
Added
Lyrics timed word by word light up each word as it is sung, from TTML or enhanced LRC on Navidrome 0.63 or newer, on Jellyfin or next to your own music, and downloads keep them for offline (#165).
A playlist ends with a few suggested songs picked from the ones already in it, each with a preview, and a Refresh button for others, thanks to @Anakin-bb8 (#227).
An album shows its description under its name, as a playlist already did, thanks to @garrit-schroeder (#223).
Settings > Appearance > Keep where you were leaves the app on the screen you left when you come back to it. Off by default (#225).
Your library can start on Favorites and your playlists again instead of everything mixed together, with Settings > Appearance > Start on your playlists (#217).
Settings > Appearance > Font can load a .ttf or .otf file of your own, thanks to @Anakin-bb8 (#227).
Home has a Random songs section, off by default, in Settings > Appearance > Home sections (#227).
Diagnostics counts every request made to the server and how long the app spends away (#221).
Swedish, thanks to @NickWick13 (#228).
Fixed
Songs play and covers show again on Jellyfin 12, where browsing worked but nothing would play (#229).
Previous goes to the track before in the album or playlist that is playing, and only back to what you played before once you reach the first track, thanks to @garrit-schroeder (#219).
On a UPnP or Sonos speaker the volume starts from the speaker's own level and follows changes made on it, thanks to @garrit-schroeder (#218).
Casting to a UPnP or Sonos speaker goes back to the phone, paused, when the phone leaves the network, and a Sonos queue that failed to load part way is sent again in full, thanks to @garrit-schroeder (#220).
Offline, a track with its own embedded cover shows it everywhere, also for albums downloaded before 0.7.7 (#214).
On Navidrome 0.64 or newer, items with no artwork show Resonus' own placeholder and are no longer asked for it.
Deleting a playlist or a radio station, or unfavouriting an album, no longer leaves a hidden pin that counts toward the limit (#217).
A playlist you have never played no longer rises to the top of the home grid for being edited on the server, thanks to @garrit-schroeder (#222).
A failed Jellyfin sign-in explains why in the app's language instead of always in Spanish.
On iOS the fonts in Settings > Appearance > Font apply, and Share, Go to artist, Go to album and Song information in the menus open, thanks to @Anakin-bb8 (#227).
Changed
The Artists, Albums and Songs lists, on Home and in Explore, remember the order you picked (#226).
You can pin up to 50 items instead of 25 (#217).
A long playlist or album description is cut to two lines with a Show more under it (#223).
Most played songs on Home is a list of songs three to a column instead of a row of covers (#227).
Lyric lines already sung stay lit instead of fading back out (#227).
The name of an album or playlist sits centred in the bar that appears when you scroll (#227).

Added
Chips under the search box narrow the results to songs, artists, albums, playlists or radio. They show up as soon as you type, and pressing the one already lit gives you everything back.
An animated cover can fill the player behind the controls, with a still copy of it beside the title, instead of playing inside the square; it starts off, under Settings > Player > Cover art, and comes from @Anakin-bb8 (#190).
Ukrainian is complete again, thanks to @albedych (#191).
The sections of Explore can be shown or hidden as well as reordered, from Settings > Appearance > Explore sections. The last one on stays on: Explore is the only way into the whole of a library, so a tab with no chips would be a catalogue with no way in.
A playlist can be a favourite, with the heart its albums and artists already have. It needs Navidrome 0.64 or newer, which is where playlist favourites start existing, and the heart simply isn't there on a server that has no way to remember it.
Polish, a complete translation, thanks to @pegaz19803-spec (#200). It also made the Language screen's own three lines translatable, which they were not in any language: they were English sitting in the code.
Navidrome 0.64 gives every song, album and playlist a new id, and the music already on the phone is filed under the old ones. Resonus now notices a server that has renumbered and rewrites the downloads, the offline library, the queue, the pins and the listens still waiting to be sent, so nothing has to be downloaded again. It only acts on proof: the server has to answer to the new id and refuse the old one, since a song that was simply deleted looks the same from outside. A server that has not migrated is left alone.
Fixed
"On cover tap" keeps what you picked. "Go to album", "Play or pause" and "Add to favorites" were thrown away when the app reopened and came back as "Open lyrics screen"; the same went for the double tap, which came back off unless it was set to play/pause or favorites. Reported by BrawlReturns.
An animated cover no longer stutters in the player: only the copy you are looking at plays, and the blurred background behind it holds still.
The popular songs on an artist's page are that artist's, where two of them share a name. They were asked for by name alone, so whichever one the server happened to reach first answered for both.
"Start mix" works with repeat turned on. It used to answer that it could not find anything to mix with the song, whichever song it was, and nothing had been looked for: the queue never runs out with repeat on, so the search that fills a mix was skipped before it began. Starting a mix now also turns repeat off, the way it already turned shuffle off (#197).
A downloaded track with a sleeve of its own shows it offline, instead of the record's. Its picture was never saved, so offline had nothing to show but the album's; downloading now brings it along, and a track without one still gets the album's as before. Albums already on the phone keep the album cover until they are downloaded again (#214).
The colour an artist's page is tinted with comes from their photo and not from the grey square standing in for it while the server is still looking the photo up, which it could keep doing for as long as the picture stayed in the cache.
Changed
Home opens with every section on. Five of them used to start off to keep it short, which mostly kept them secret: a section nobody has seen is one nobody knows to look for in the settings. Turn off what you do not want from Settings > Appearance > Home sections. Anyone who has already set these keeps what they chose.
"Your library" opens on everything you have, playlists, favourite albums and favourite artists in one list saying which is which, and the chips narrow it from there instead of being the only way to see any of it.
The chip you press in "Your library" is now the only one left in the row, behind an X that gives the whole library back, and Playlists brings Yours and Public with it, each when it has something to leave out; picking one of those leaves the two words sitting together as one answer.
The search box of Explore is now behind the same magnifier "Your library" has, at the top right, where it becomes the X that puts the box away; Back closes it too, and a section opens on its list rather than on a box you were not looking for.

Added
A fourth tab, Explore, holding everything the server has: playlists, albums, artists, songs, genres, radio stations and folders, each with its own search and orders.
The tabs at the bottom can be reordered, and all but Home hidden, in Settings > Appearance > Navigation bar.
The icons at the top of Home can be reordered too, and all but the gear hidden, in Settings > Appearance > Home buttons. There is a new one among them, a search button that opens the box with the cursor already in it, off by default.
The row playing in a list shows a set of bars that move while it plays and settle when you pause it.
One tap and two on the player's artwork now offer the same actions, the album among them.
Holding a playlist on the Home shelf opens the same menu the library gives it (#182).
Italian is complete again, and Explicit, Clean and Lyrics read as Italian instead of English, thanks to @Anakin-bb8 (#189).
An icon of its own on iOS, also thanks to @Anakin-bb8 (#189).
Fixed
The queue saved on the server no longer overwrites a newer one another player left there, and a queue that has only been restored, never played, is not sent at all (#188).
"Add to queue" puts what you add at the end of the queue, where "Play next" already put things right after the current song (#184).
The queue's headings say where each stretch of it came from, instead of leaving songs you added under the name of a record none of them are on (#184).
"New releases" shows the newest records instead of a slice of the alphabet.
Offline mode no longer looks for a new version of Resonus by itself (#179).
The dropdowns in Settings open flush against their row again.
Opening Your library for the first time no longer draws it under the status bar for an instant.
Changed
The library tab is now called "Your library", and it sits last at the bottom, behind Explore.
The row of chips on Home is now called "Home chips" and not "Explore chips", which named the Explore tab it has nothing to do with. The order you put them in survives the rename.
"Pick up the queue from other players" starts on, so a queue left on another device is taken as well as sent. It was only ever sent before (#188).
Albums and artists open as rows rather than as a grid, and the view button still switches them.
Browsing all albums, all artists and all songs picks its order from a menu that says which one is on, instead of a scrolling row of pills, and the albums and the songs gained play and shuffle beside it.
A genre card says how many albums it holds and fans out the covers of its first two.
The album and year line in the player scrolls when it does not fit (#183).
Song, album and artist rows dim under the finger, late enough that scrolling past one never lights it up.
Corners are rounder throughout, sheets and panels most of all.
Folders moved out of Your library and into Explore, which is where the rest of the server's catalogue now lives.
The setting that picked which actions a song's ⋯ menu shows is gone: every action is back in it, and each one is still only there when it applies.
The avatar on Home is gone, and the setting that showed it: it was never a button, and the account is one tap away behind the gear beside it.

Added
More than one folder for the local profile, in Settings > Local music, and adding one only reads the new folder (#158).
A "New releases" shelf on Home, off by default, ordered by the year the albums came out (#173).
The theme can follow the phone's own light or dark setting, and changes with it while the app is open (#173).
Dark and light each remember their own accent colour (#173).
The queue another player left on the server can be brought over from the ⋯ of the queue screen, or picked up on opening with a new switch in Settings > Playback.
Tapping the player's artwork twice can play, pause or favourite the song, off by default in Settings > Player (#156).
An album, a playlist or the favourites can be played next from their ⋯ menu.
A card with the artist's photo and biography under the player controls, off by default, thanks to @Anakin-bb8.
A selection of songs can be exported to a folder, or have its downloads deleted, from the ⋯ of the selection bar (#164).
Italian is much more complete, over 140 strings, thanks to @Anakin-bb8; German and Russian are up to date, thanks to @CraftoHohenvels and @ztx-lyghters.
Fixed
The sleep timer's "When the song ends" stops on the right song (#177).
The server's Now Playing panel follows the song instead of sitting at 0:00.
Dragging the progress bar moves the time under it.
Listens saved offline reach the server on reconnect.
The last song in the queue no longer sits under the navigation bar.
ALAC plays where the phone's own decoder refuses it (#134), thanks to @zskruc.
Casting to a UPnP renderer no longer stops with the screen locked, thanks to @matthewmoonen.
Sonos handles the queue properly: editing it, turning shuffle off, skipping inside it, and crossfade, thanks to @garrit-schroeder.
On iOS, next and previous work from the lock screen, the Dynamic Island, Bluetooth and the car, and the accent colour takes the colour of the cover, thanks to @Anakin-bb8.
Changed
The local profile asks its catalog for the rows it is about to draw instead of holding the library in memory, so opening it stops costing what the whole library costs.
The local profile no longer stops at five thousand songs per folder.
Folders are followed ten levels deep instead of six.
The selection bar keeps two buttons and a ⋯ with the rest, so favouriting several songs at once is where you would look for it (#164).
Headings sit at weight 600: Android draws Roboto's 800 as a real ExtraBold and it closed the letters up.
The genre grid on Search lost its "Browse all" heading.
Expo SDK 57 and React Native 0.86 underneath, media3 unchanged at 1.9.0.
